scope: Full game localization, including UI, missions, upgrades, subtitles and Web of Intrigue
credits: Translate headings, departments and job titles; preserve all personal names verbatim
real_world_companies_and_brands: Preserve original English spelling, including Activision and Radical Entertainment
fictional_organizations: Translate all in-universe companies, organizations and project names into consistent Chinese; Gentek is 基因科技. Preserve real-world credits company names under the separate credits rule.
codename_punctuation: 游戏内用作代号的称呼统一使用中文双引号，如“宙斯”、“弃民”和“红冠”。完整呼号连同编号一起标注，如“幽灵十二号”。行动、计划的类别词放在引号外，如“防火带”行动。普通亲属称谓、地名及一般描述按原句语境处理。
environment_texture_text: Retain original lettering on street signs, advertisements and posters, as explicitly confirmed by user on 2026-11-13
coverage_rule: Count each discovered text system independently. AudioDialogueSubtitle, text holders, GFX controls and player-visible script literals must be inventoried; untranslated or unintegrated entries cannot be reported as complete.

required_baselines: Steam English original + modern patch + localization
independence.implementation: Native localization resources plus a self-owned game-local entry for native UI memory support. No Modern loader/module prerequisite and no on-disk engine edits; unrelated XInput calls are forwarded unchanged to the absolute system DLL.
independence.acceptance: Validate actual play separately for both baselines; file installation checks do not establish gameplay acceptance

geographical_names: Use Chinese names for in-game textual place names and facilities, preferring established Chinese names for real places. Environmental texture lettering remains unchanged.

EP.source: Official Prototype instruction manual; original UI explicitly expands EP (EVOLUTION POINTS).
